verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-controlled data retention periods and no way to delete data Oneleet has already stored. The closest feature is the AWS `oneleet-ignore=true` tag, which stops resources from being read in at all. That is an adjacent collection-scoping control, not retention or deletion of stored data, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: You can prevent AWS resources from being read into Oneleet by adding the tag `oneleet-ignore=true` for resources which support tagging.
